headers.comment: Asset filenames carry a content hash, so a cached copy can never be the wrong one. Cache them for a year.

The opposite case, and the one that matters: sw.js and index.html change every deploy and keep no hash. A stale index is a list of chunk hashes the server no longer has, and a stale worker keeps serving it. Browsers already revalidate a service worker script, but say so rather than rely on it.
